stepExplanation: Black fur requires at least one B allele (probability 3/4). Long hair requires homozygous ss (probability 1/4). Multiply: 3/4 x 1/4 = **3/16**.
stepBody: For black fur with long hair, the offspring needs B_ (at least one B) and ss (homozygous recessive). Using probability multiplication, what fraction of offspring will show this phenotype?
